===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[MediaTek]] MT7981BA @1.3GHz (''Filogic 820'') :SoC: Dual-core ARM (Cortex-A53) *Storage: 16MB (SPI NOR), 256MB (SPI NAND) Flash :M.2 2242/2230 socket for NVMe SSD (PCIe Gen 2 x1) *Memory: 1GB (DDR4) SDRAM ([[Micron]]) *Wi-Fi: [[MediaTek]] MT7981BA/MT7976CN :802.11abgn/ac/ax Dual Band (2.4/5GHz) :2×2 2.4GHz, 3×3 5GHz (2×2 + Zero-wait DFS) *Network: 1x 2.5GbE, 1x 1GbE ports *PCIe: NGFF M.2 (Key M) socket (PCIe Gen 2 x1) *USB: 1x USB 2.0 (Type-A) Host port, :1x USB (Type-C) [device, console] port *Power Source: 15V/2A via USB (Type-C) :(supports PD) or 802.3af/at PoE
